audit.whatIsWrong: Four writable strings build strategy around a "Most Wanted" mechanic on Demacian Justice: whys[4] "his R is only lethal if you are Most Wanted and already low"; mid "his Demacian Justice becomes a genuine kill threat if you are the Most Wanted target"; late "Garen's Demacian Justice executes whoever is Most Wanted"; spikes[3].text "if you are the Most Wanted target and drop below half HP".
audit.why: Demacian Justice has no Villain / Most Wanted marking. It is a flat true-damage execute scaling with the target's missing health against any enemy champion, on a 120/100/80 cooldown. This is dangerous as written because it tells a Teemo he is safe from the ult unless he is 'Most Wanted' — a condition that does not exist, so he will stand in execute range believing he is exempt.
audit.corrected: Demacian Justice executes anyone: 125/200/275 plus 25/30/35% of the target's missing health as true damage, 120s at rank 1. The only variable that matters is how low your HP bar is.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen — Demacian Justice: no Villain mechanic; '125 / 200 / 275 (+ 25 / 30 / 35% of target's missing health)', cooldown 120/100/80

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentions that Decisive Strike cleanses slows, despite the entire mid/late plan being 'shroom him and kite'.
audit.why: Decisive Strike cleanses Garen of all slows on cast and gives 35% bonus movement speed. That directly negates the two slows this matchup tells Teemo to rely on — Noxious Trap and Rylai's. mid currently says mushrooms make his engage path cost 20-30% HP and treats the slow as the reason he cannot reach you; in practice the mushroom damage lands but the slow evaporates the moment he presses Q. A Teemo who plans a retreat on the assumption the shroom slow will hold gets caught.
audit.corrected: Mushrooms zone Garen, they do not hold him — Decisive Strike cleanses every slow you land and adds 35% movement speed on top. Use shrooms for the damage and the reveal, and keep a real escape route.
sources: champ-data/_kits/garen.json (Q Decisive Strike: 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him')
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen — 'cleanses himself of all slows and gains 35% bonus movement speed'

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0]: "Activate Courage (W) right before your Q lands so the damage reduction absorbs the blind window and his passive regen clears your poison".
audit.why: Two false mechanics in one line. Courage grants a shield, 60% tenacity for the first 0.75 seconds and then damage reduction — it does nothing to a blind, which is not damage and is not crowd control he can shrug with tenacity. And Perseverance is health regeneration that switches off whenever Garen takes damage or is hit by an enemy ability, so a ticking Toxic Shot poison suppresses it rather than being cleared by it. What Garen actually wants at that moment is Decisive Strike, to shed your slow and close.
audit.corrected: His real play is Decisive Strike to cleanse the slow and close with 35% bonus move speed. Courage buys him damage reduction and 0.75s of 60% tenacity; it does not touch the blind, and Perseverance stays switched off for as long as your poison is ticking.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen — Courage: '60% Tenacity' for 'the first 0.75 seconds' of a 4-second duration; Perseverance regeneration disabled when he 'takes damage... or if he is hit by an enemy ability'

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] "Max-ranked Q doubles down on the pattern", mid "a max-ranked Blinding Shot shuts down Garen's damage", spikes[1].text "Q is max-ranked" — all at Levels 4-5.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is rank 2-3 at levels 4-5 and maxes at level 9, and its cooldown is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so there is no 'max-ranked Q' spike to double down on at this stage.
audit.corrected: Q is rank 2-3; the stage advantage is mushroom coverage, not a Q rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Courage as the matchup-defining cooldown and tells the player to 'poke when down', but neither layer states its duration or cooldown; mid only says 'it is long at early ranks'.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12. Naming 22 seconds at rank 1 turns a vague instruction into an actual trade timer, and the tenacity window is only the first 0.75 seconds of a 4-second effect — which is why waiting out the W rather than fighting through it is correct.
audit.corrected: Courage is 22s at rank 1, falling to 12s at rank 5; the tenacity portion is only the first 0.75s. Poke through the tail of it, commit on the downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: early says to stay "just outside his Q range (about 350 units)".
audit.why: Decisive Strike's listed range is 300, not 350. Overstating it by 50 units in the safe direction is harmless, but it is still a wrong number in an entry whose whole early-game instruction is a spacing rule, and the kit carries the real figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Blinding Shot" appears in whys[0], early, spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1].

audit.why: No such item; the Teemo full layer writes it as Liandry's Torment.

The entry's central claim — that Decisive Strike is an empowered basic attack and therefore dies to a blind, and that a ticking poison keeps Perseverance switched off — is right on both counts and is the reason this is a 52.81% lane. I left that reasoning intact.
sources: champ-data/_kits/garen.json (Q: 'His next attack strikes a vital area', flags autoReset; P Perseverance)

audit.why: 52.81% over 1441 games with a chart giving Teemo 6/7 stages and Skill at 2+ items — consistent.

edits.before: Garen's entire level-1 kit is one empowered Q auto and a passive that regens HP when you stop hitting him — Blinding Shot answers both. Fire Q the instant he steps up to last-hit; he swings into a blind, eats E poison ticks, and walks away having dealt zero damage. The only thing to respect is his Q silence: if he lands it before you can fire your dart, he gets a free empowered auto plus the start of Judgment into your body, so always stay just outside his Q range (about 350 units) and let him walk into YOUR auto range, not the other way around. His passive regen is irrelevant as long as your E poison is ticking — every trade should end with three or more stacks on him so the DoT negates his regeneration window.
edits.after: Garen's entire level-1 kit is one empowered Q auto and a passive that regens HP when you stop hitting him — Blinding Dart answers both. His passive regen is irrelevant as long as your E poison is ticking — every trade should end with three or more stacks on him so the DoT keeps Perseverance switched off.

edits.before: By levels 4-5, a max-ranked Blinding Shot shuts down Garen's damage completely on every trade, and your mushroom placement starts dictating where he can safely stand. Drop shrooms in the tribush and both river entrances so any engage path he takes costs him 20-30% HP before he even gets in auto range. The Courage (W) cooldown is your trade timer: it is long at early ranks and you can feel it easily — he activates it, you back off and poke with autos from max range until it drops, then re-engage with the full pattern. Never take an extended fight while Courage is up; the damage reduction and tenacity let him spin through your poison long enough to deal real damage. At level 6, his Demacian Justice becomes a genuine kill threat if you are the Most Wanted target and your HP is low — always have a W-speed escape path planned and keep mushrooms on your retreat route into your jungle.
edits.after: By levels 4-5 the blind-poison loop shuts Garen's damage down on every trade, and your mushroom placement starts dictating where he can safely stand. Drop shrooms in the tribush and both river entrances so any engage path costs him 20-30% HP before he gets in auto range — but know that Decisive Strike cleanses all slows, so a shroom slows him only until he presses Q. The Courage (W) cooldown is your trade timer: 22 seconds at rank 1, and you can feel it easily — he activates it, you back off and poke with autos from max range until it drops, then re-engage with the full pattern. Never take an extended fight while Courage is up; 60% tenacity for the first 0.75s plus the damage reduction lets him spin through your poison long enough to deal real damage. At 6, Demacian Justice is a missing-health true-damage execute — always have a W-speed escape path and keep mushrooms on your retreat route.

edits.before: In side lane split-push, a shroom-warded lane makes Garen nearly helpless — he cannot safely chase you through mushrooms, and his only answer to your zone control is to stand still and regen, which your E poison overrides entirely. Where you have to be careful is objective fights: Garen's Demacian Justice executes whoever is Most Wanted, and in a chaotic teamfight you can drop to half HP fast enough for him to R you from range before your W can carry you out. Play the side lane, force him to answer you there, and if you must fight with your team, stay at the edge of the fight and poke rather than walking into Judgment range.
